title: TLS hostname verification disabled in VeNCrypt security handshake
detail: ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT sets check_hostname=True and verify_mode=CERT_REQUIRED by default. Line 152 explicitly sets ssl_ctx.check_hostname = False, disabling hostname validation while keeping certificate chain validation. The code's stated goal (comment at line 105) is to prevent MITM attacks; however, without hostname checking, any certificate signed by the same CA (CONF.vnc.vencrypt_ca_certs) from any compute node satisfies verification. An attacker with access to a CA-signed certificate for a different compute node could redirect the proxy connection to a different target within the management network. The server-side socket (compute_sock) connects to the QEMU VNC backend on an internal compute node.
